scene: The blue tea makes you float slightly beside three waiting departures.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a bustling transport junction. Far left, an open wicker cloud cable pod dangles above a wooden platform. Left, the broad-shouldered Pacific Islander man floats inches off the ground holding his ukulele. Right, a streamlined pink bullet train sits with open doors. Far right, a green solar-sail junk rocks gently at a canal dock.
shown: a dangling round wicker cable pod hanging open on the far left
a sleek pink bullet train with open doors on the right
a green wooden junk with glowing solar sails on the far right
